title: Extra-Guest-Fee Refund Amount on a Cancelled Stay
content:
# Extra-guest-fee refund — how the amount is reached

**Clause.** On a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that recorded an extra-guest fee, the extra-guest-fee refund counts the extra-guest-refundable nights, the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date less the nights the extra-guest-fee refund holds back for notice, and it holds back 1 of them. The share of the extra-guest fee returned is the nightly amount refunded on the same cancellation divided by the stay's nightly subtotal. The extra-guest-fee refund is the extra-guest fee recorded on the stay times that share, rounded half up to the cent, and it is paid to the guest's card in full.

**Which nights are extra-guest-refundable?**
Those dated after the cancellation date (the date part of the cancellation time on the stay) and before the check-out date, less the 1 night held back for notice, never below zero. A cancellation dated before check-in has all of the stay's nights after its date.

**Where does the nightly amount refunded come from?**
From the nightly refunds with the guest-cancellation reason on the stay's ledger.

**What is the amount, worked through?**
Take a hypothetical 6-night stay with a nightly subtotal of 1,200.00 and an extra-guest fee of 90.00 recorded at booking, whose ledger shows a guest-cancellation nightly refund of 400.00. The share is 400.00 divided by 1,200.00, one third; the refund is 90.00 times one third, 30.00, all of it paid to the guest's card.

**And with no nightly refund on the ledger?**
The share is 0 and the extra-guest-fee refund is 0.00.
